summary: Short, steep residential kerb with homes 16 m away; not worth stopping.

best_section.where: Dennis Street south kerb, short stretch under trees near the bend

drivers.seclusion: Detached dwellings at 16, 17 and 21 m on both sides; houses all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Quiet street with cars parked at the kerb; 16 m is barely a van length.
drivers.convention: Some cars park on the street, but no campervan sign seen.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the start; open to afternoon sun further along.
